description: Returns the lists on the signed-in shopper's Plendio account: wishlists, shopping lists and favourites they own, and lists other people have shared with them. Each has its list_id, title, kind, the shopper's role on it (owner, editor or viewer), item count, who it is for and the event date when set, and its links. Requires sign-in.

market.description: Market for the links in the answer: dk, se, de or no. Default: the market of the site you connected to.

name: list_my_wishlists
title: List my lists
